nail_bed_anchor.meaning: proximal edge (cuticle) of the natural nail plate on its centre line; identical in all four tones (measured 279/401 each)

main_nail.rule: press-on visible width = 1.08 x natural plate width; sprite cell anchor (0.5, 0.925) on the nail-bed anchor

vs_phase1: P1 fingers: anchor (0.5, 0.2649), cell 0.5 of canvas width (cell scale 0.76). HD: same anchor, cell 0.474 of canvas width (main nail ~5% narrower relative to the finger).
